story.title: A Tale of Two Mice
paragraphs_en: One day, Hank the Mouse sneaked into a room with a computer. He was very hungry.
He tiptoed slowly to the computer and saw a little computer mouse. "What are you doing here?" asked Computer Mouse. " "I'm trying to find something to eat," answered Hank.
He saw a yellow pencil and thought to himself, "Hmmm, is this a cheese stick?" He quickly took a bite. ''Yuck!''
Computer Mouse showed Hank a picture of a large tray of cake in the kitchen. Hank's mouth watered and he felt even hungrier. He crept to the kitchen, where Lucy the Cat was asleep.
Hank brought the cake to the room and shared it with Computer Mouse. They both liked its sweet taste. "Yum!"cried Hank and Computer Mouse. They especially loved the icing on top.
While they were enjoying the cake, Lucy the Cat woke up, ran out of the kitchen and appeared in front of the computer.
"It's the cat! It's the cat!" Hank cried. He ran this way and that, willy-nilly, round and back. Computer Mouse quickly showed a picture of a dog and Lucy the Cat ran away.
Hank was about to leave. "Wait!" cried Computer Mouse, "Don't just leave me here. Please break the wire with your teeth."
Finally, Computer Mouse was free. They planned to move to a bigger house with more cake and no cats. And they lived happily ever after.
